preconditions.description: The number of pairs of nodes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges must be exactly 2n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 2 * n and 1 <= b <= 2 * n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to place the tree on the table modulo 1000000007.
